name: Voltron WhatsApp Bot
description: Voltron: WhatsApp AI bot with an AI assistant, group tools, stickers, downloader, view-once saver and games.

SESSION_ID.description: Login from .exportsession (starts with VOLTRON:~). Leave empty and set USE_PAIRING_CODE=true to link with a pairing code from the logs.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only (e.g. 2348012345678).

OWNER_NAME.description: Your name, shown in the menu.

USE_PAIRING_CODE.description: true = log in with an 8-character pairing code printed in the logs.

TIMEZONE.description: Time zone for the menu and reports.

AI_API_KEY.description: API key for the AI assistant (optional).
